_about: Hive Mind factory, layer 2: which checks cover which files. A check runs at the end of a turn when a changed file is one of its entries, is reached from an entry through static imports (relative paths and the @/ alias, found by the program), or matches one of its hand-kept 'covers' globs (what imports cannot show: files loaded by a computed path, settings, scripts). Paths are relative to the notebook, with forward slashes. 'manual' checks need a running server or a build; they are named to Claude, never run by the hook. This copy starts with two checks; add one for each program or page you build, and keep it by hand.
